title: 20-Minute Driving Tour: Hollywood to Sunset Blvd in a Lamborghini
blurb:
Experience Hollywood from behind the wheel—or from the passenger seat—of an exotic Lamborghini Huracán on this private sightseeing tour. Choose to drive the Lamborghini yourself or relax while your professional guide takes the wheel, giving you the flexibility to enjoy the experience your way.

During your 20-minute adventure, cruise along the famous Hollywood Walk of Fame and through the streets of Hollywood while taking in iconic landmarks and the excitement of driving—or riding in—one of the world's most recognizable supercars. Whether you're a driving enthusiast or simply looking for a unique way to explore Los Angeles, this unforgettable experience combines luxury, adrenaline, and sightseeing in one incredible tour.
